product.title: Stat Inventor
product.summary: Invent a scoring formula, then see who it crowns.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students explore real player statistics across sports, star the players they rate, then build their own weighted formula in plain language and watch it decide a champion — discovering that what you choose to measure decides who wins.

facilitation.notes: Students copy a share link that a teacher pastes into the separate Teacher Collector tool. That collector is a facilitator dashboard, not a student experience, so it is not a Library entry.

product.technology: Alpine.js static site with real season data

studentDataProfile.notes: State kept in browser localStorage only; no server call observed.

governance.maturityBasis: Complete and reachable, with a share-link path into the facilitator collector. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. The weighting sliders and leaderboard recompute correctly, but the charting half of the tool does not run at all.
knownBlockers: The "Your Chart" panel renders as an empty box. Four "Cannot read properties of null" errors fire on load before any interaction, followed by "Maximum call stack size exceeded" — consistent with a broken chart-library init.
On a phone the stats table silently drops the STL column rather than scrolling, so data disappears instead of being reachable.

curation.tierBasis: A sound metric-construction lab whose charting half does not run at all, and whose phone layout silently drops a data column.

provenance.evidence: BSC-BUILDANALYTIC/index.html describes the Track 101 lane as 'Explore player data, build your own scoring formula using stars, and crown your champion' for 'Grades 5–6'.
